uncited: It builds on [Direct volume ray casting](19-direct-volume-ray-casting.md) by modifying the ray traversal and compositing stages to respect the cutting plane boundary.
The method integrates a cutting plane into the ray casting loop.
The plane is defined by a position and orientation, and optionally a near-clip constraint.
*   **Cutting Plane Check:** Let $\mathbf{g}_{in} = \mathbf{p}_i$ and $\mathbf{g}_{out} = \mathbf{p}_{i+1}$ in world space.
